name: Internet
overview: Scripture acknowledges the increase of knowledge and movement in the last days, as noted in Daniel 12:4, which corresponds with the widespread use of the internet. While the internet enables global communication and the fulfillment of the Great Commission (Matthew 24:14; Mark 16:15), believers are urged to exercise discernment and avoid vanity (Proverbs 14:15; Psalms 119:37). Additionally, Luke 12:2 reminds us that nothing remains hidden, emphasizing the importance of integrity and truthfulness in all online interactions, including internet dating.
